name: draft_topk1
description: draft_topk1(next_token_logits, positions, draft_tokens=None, draft_token_column=0) -> (topk_p, topk_index, out_positions, out_draft_tokens). next_token_logits is [B, V] float32 and positions is an integer [B] tensor. Each row finds the global argmax over the vocabulary, using lowest-index tie-breaking. topk_p is a new float32 [B, 1] tensor filled with 1.0; topk_index is the new int64 argmax tensor shaped [B, 1]; out_positions is positions + 1 as int64 [B]. If draft_tokens is provided as [B, C], out_draft_tokens is a clone with column draft_token_column replaced by the selected argmax and is otherwise unchanged; negative draft_token_column values wrap from the end. If draft_tokens is None, out_draft_tokens is None. No input is mutated. The vocab is processed via direct, streaming, or partitioned argmax paths depending on size.
